controllerAdjudication.finding: Missing server-side hash verification on every MinIO download
controllerAdjudication.judgment: A source-derived corrupted-object scenario is not a falsification of the normal-download observation or QA requirement to measure real file size/hash. No corrupted-object probe ran and the v2 invariants do not claim universal server-side bitrot/tamper prevention. Keep this unverified threat explicit; do not label it a confirmed reproduced regression or change the streaming API merely to satisfy the mistaken grade.

controllerAdjudication.finding: Persisted FAILED row after database finalization failure makes object permanently unreclaimable
controllerAdjudication.state: NOT_CONFIRMED; cited failure sequence is incorrect
controllerAdjudication.judgment: The actual finalization catch cleans up and rethrows RuntimeException, so the outer transaction rolls back; it does not commit a FAILED row through that path. The independently persisted pre-upload marker survives rollback. A FAILED row after uncertain PUT failure is a referenced retry artifact under the current retention contract, not an unreferenced orphan. Do not clear a NOT NULL protected object_key or delete retained user artifacts without a settled retention decision.

controllerAdjudication.finding: Built-in source/skill profiles absent because glob returned nothing
controllerAdjudication.judgment: Other runtime contexts loaded the exact original descriptions and Wukong references. Ignore/read-surface discovery failure does not prove absence. Individual reviews with limited profile/reference access remain degraded; no qualified full AgentKit/model route is claimed.

controllerAdjudication.finding: Hikari hard-unwrap and two extra connections per instance
controllerAdjudication.judgment: Committed runtime and fresh integration tests use Hikari. Non-Hikari datasource compatibility, extra production quota, monitoring and capacity remain unverified and must be checked before deployment.

controllerAdjudication.finding: Lock contention before per-source authorization and >300s in-flight object cleanup window
controllerAdjudication.judgment: Patient scope is checked before locking, but finer source authorization follows it. Long-stall and hostile contention cases are not executed in this gate. No universal capacity/recovery claim is made.
